issue.body:
**Description**
Unable to setup beats like: [Auditbeat, packetbeat, filebeat] after installation of the agent on ON-PREM environment.

**Build Details:**
```
Version: 7.13.0 BC5
Build: 40845
Commit: ffb66d357906e1e81a22e3fb11af7b65f00c934a
Artifacts:https://staging.elastic.co/7.13.0-40842f6d/summary-7.13.0.html
```

**Browser Details:**
All

**Preconditions:**
1. Kibana should be up.
2. Agent and Endpoint should be installed.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Open the yml file of beat say auditbeat.yml.
2. uncomment the username and password.
3. Run the command ".\install-service-auditbeat.ps1" in the power shell.
4. Rune the command ".\auditbeat.exe setup"
5. Observe that the below error is displayed:
```
"Exiting: failed to check for alias 'auditbeat-7.13.0': (status=400) {"error":{"root_cause":[{"type":"illegal_argument_exception","reason":"Data stream(s) [.fleet-actions-results] use and access is reserved for system operations"}],"type":"illegal_argument_exception","reason":"Data stream(s) [.fleet-actions-results] use and access is reserved for system operations"},"status":400}: 400 Bad Request: {"error":{"root_cause":[{"type":"illegal_argument_exception","reason":"Data stream(s) [.fleet-actions-results] use and access is reserved for system operations"}],"type":"illegal_argument_exception","reason":"Data stream(s) [.fleet-actions-results] use and access is reserved for system operations"},"status":400}"
```

**Impacted Test case:**
N/A

**Actual Result:**
Unable to setup beats like: [Auditbeat, packetbeat, filebeat] after installation of the agent on ON-PREM environment.

**Expected Result:**
Beats like: [Auditbeat, packetbeat, filebeat] should be run after installation of the agent on ON-PREM environment.

**What's working:**
N/A

**What's not working:**
N/A

issue.title: Beats fail to setup indices with 7.13 if .fleet-actions-results datastream is created

repository.name: beats
repository.description: :tropical_fish: Beats - Lightweight shippers for Elasticsearch & Logstash

issue.body:
This issue was originally reported in https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/100019

The repro steps on clean Elasticsearch 7.13:

```
curl -X POST -u elastic:changeme "localhost:9200/.fleet-actions-results/_doc" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-elastic-product-origin: fleet' -d'{}'
```

```
curl -u elastic:changeme "localhost:9200/_alias/auditbeat-7.13.0"  
```

Returns an error:
```
{
  "error" : {
    "root_cause" : [
      {
        "type" : "illegal_argument_exception",
        "reason" : "Data stream(s) [.fleet-actions-results] use and access is reserved for system operations"
      }
    ],
    "type" : "illegal_argument_exception",
    "reason" : "Data stream(s) [.fleet-actions-results] use and access is reserved for system operations"
  },
  "status" : 400
}
```


The impact:
The beats indices setup will fail after the first document is pushed into ```.fleet-actions-results``` datastream.


This seems to be a regression caused by the addition of the fleet system datastream with the fleet system index plugin, and would have to be addressed on ES side. Opened this issue in beats repository as requested for tracking purposes.

issue.title: Handle the existence of system data streams in Get Aliases API

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This commit adjusts the behavior of the Get Aliases API to more
thoroughly prevent errors and warnings from being emitted unnecessarily
from the Get Aliases API by retrieving all indices including system ones
and only warning in the post processing of the action.

Additionally, the IndexAbstractionResolver has been updated to properly
handle system data streams when evaluating visibility.

Closes #73218
Co-authored-by: jaymode <jay@elastic.co>
